record.title: Questions
record.why: The pages cover who the studio is and what it offers, but nothing gathers the practical questions a prospective client has before getting in touch, such as how far the studio travels, whether it builds as well as designs, and how long projects take.
record.notes: Follow the house page order: a warm tagline, a one-line intro, a call to action, short question-and-answer sections, an image caption, a client quote with attribution, and a closing question with a "Book a consultation" button. Talk about cost only in principle. [Need: the studio's real answers on area covered, typical timescales, build partners and aftercare, plus a client quote.]
